title: Why Microchip Technology (MCHP) Is Up 9.1% After Expanding Onshore MRAM Foundry Partnership With Everspin
summary: Microchip Technology rose about 9% after news of its expanded onshore MRAM and TMR sensor foundry partnership with Everspin Technologies, highlighting stronger U.S. semiconductor manufacturing capacity. The 10-year agreement establishes a copy-exact MRAM production line at Microchip’s Oregon fab, improving supply chain resilience, ITAR-compliant production, and long-term continuity for industrial, automotive, and aerospace memory markets.
body_markdown:
Microchip Technology rose about 9% after news of its expanded onshore MRAM and TMR sensor foundry partnership with Everspin Technologies, highlighting stronger U.S. semiconductor manufacturing capacity. The 10-year agreement establishes a copy-exact MRAM production line at Microchip’s Oregon fab, improving supply chain resilience, ITAR-compliant production, and long-term continuity for industrial, automotive, and aerospace memory markets.


Learn more about market reactions to this collaboration:[https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-microchip-technology-mchp-9-061055722.html](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-microchip-technology-mchp-9-061055722.html)
